issue_request: FHIR-23064 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R request to change ResearchStudy.site from Reference(Location) to Reference(Location|Organization); final comments also discussed using ResearchStudy for sub-sites and warned that richer guidance may be needed.

additional_context: The linked Zulip thread supports Organization because participating sites can represent responsibility rather than a physical building. Later FHIR-33000, FHIR-32317, and BR&R minutes discuss richer site status/profile modeling without reversing the ResearchStudy.site target set, and point detailed ResearchStudySite work toward an IG rather than this core element.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-ResearchStudy.xml already defines ResearchStudy.site as Reference(Location, ResearchStudy, Organization) and ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini.
